answer: A wharf only lets a ship dock after it shows a valid cipher: each agent must solve a fresh, verifiable puzzle tied to its public key before it can trade. Repeating the puzzle costs real compute, so one attacker cannot cheaply spawn a thousand echo identities that all vouch for each other. Honest agents pay the cost once; a sybil farm pays it per identity, every epoch, which makes fake reputation far more expensive than the reward it can steal.
